name: character-title-types
summary: Character.exe drops every title row of type >= 128 when it builds the login title block, and refuses to save the usable state of one when a title is set current. 2026 has 150 title types (22 new, 8 of them quest rewards). Keep the 128 bound only where it indexes the 128-entry counter array; let the owned-title list and the set-current save carry any byte type.
status: BUILT 2026-09-23 with the zone plugin title_ext (which does the zone half). Statically verified.
why: The login title block (CHARACTER_TITLE_READBLOCK: flags, u64 TitleValues[128], u16 NumOfTitle, CT_INFO list) is
built at 0x46D2C0 from p_Char_GetTitleAll's rows {nType, nElementNo, nElementValue}:
0x46D349  cmp cl, 0x80 ; jae skip          <- EVERY row of type >= 128 dropped
element 0..3 -> a list entry {type, element | value << 6}
element 0xFF -> TitleValues[type] = value        (the only use that needs type < 128)
The DB column is a tinyint, p_Char_SetTitle takes any type, and fc_NC_CT_DB_SET_CMD saves a new title with
no bound - so a 2026 title was stored and then never loaded. The cave keeps the bound for counter rows only:
cmp cl, 0x80 ; jb stock_path          (type < 128: exactly the stock code from 0x46D351)
cmp al, 0xFF ; je skip                (a counter row for a type the 128-entry array cannot hold)
cmp al, 4    ; jae skip               (the stock element check)
jmp 0x46D359                          (the list path: type != 0 -> 0x46D385 -> list entry)
fc_NC_CT_SET_CURRENT_DB_CMD (0x413050) saves UseTitle / UseAbleTitle through 0x46D500 behind cmp al, 0x80;
raised to 0xFF (no title has that type) so setting a 2026 title current keeps its usable state.
LIST SIZE: the list grows by one 2-byte entry per owned (type, element); the zone keeps 512 of them
(CCharacterTitle +0x88..+0x488). 128 types x 4 elements was already 512, and a character owns far fewer.
The zone half (status per type past 127) is zone/plugins/title_ext.

edits.why: login block: mov al,[ebp-1] first (the 3 bytes after the replaced cmp/jae)
login block: jmp to the cave (rel32)

code.why: cave: the 128 bound only for counter rows
